title: Session-Only Credentials
description: As a security-conscious user, I want database credentials to be used only for the current session so that they are not persisted or leaked.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user has connected to PostgreSQL, when the session ends (page refresh, close, or logout), then credentials are cleared and not stored on disk or in browser storage
